standards.text: The learners demonstrate understanding of the fundamentals of technical drafting, tools and materials in manual drafting, mensuration and calculation, drafting conventions, architectural symbols, and details in producing architectural plans.
The learners create accurate technical drawings, and architectural plans observing relevant building codes, standards, and conventions.

The learners demonstrate an understanding of drafting principles, techniques, and industry standards including mastering manual drafting, knowledge of various disciplines (architectural, structural, electrical, plumbing, mechanical).
The learners create manual Structural, Electrical, Electronic, and Mechanical plans projects observing relevant building codes, standards, and conventions.
The learners demonstrate an understanding of CAD software installation, interface navigation, creation of 2D and 3D geometries, and produce accurate 2D architectural and structural plans in CAD
The learners create 2D and 3D geometries, and detailed 2D architectural and structural plans projects using CAD software observing relevant building codes, standards, and conventions.

The learners demonstrate an understanding in using Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software to create detailed 2D and 3D drawings of various building systems, and compute project cost estimate align to the industry standards.

The learners create 2D and 3D Computer-Aided Design (CAD) layouts project integrating Electrical, Electronic, Mechanical plans, Architectural Model and compute project cost estimate observing relevant building codes, standards, and conventions.
